## Asset

The register's unit. `identifier` is a **Record Identifier** (`AST-{yyyy}-{seq4}`), custody is a **Record Owner** on the field named `ownership` (so the shared **Assign Owner** command accepts it) plus an append-only `custodyLog` of **Custody Transfer** events, place is a **Location** link (locations nest via `parent`), coverage is a **Warranty**, value is **Acquisition** + **Condition Grade** (Sole Vault fields), links are a **Relationship Set** and **External References**.

`status` (Asset Status, catalog `statusField` with a transition graph) is written only by commands: Raise / Complete Work Order, Transfer Custody, Dispose Asset. `nextDueLabel`, `lastServicedAt`, `primaryMeterValue/Unit` are stamped by the plan and meter commands so fitted tiles show them without resolving links.

Computed join keys: `categoryId`, `locationId`, `parentAssetId`; display: `tag`, `categoryName`, `locationName`, `custodianName`.

### Formats
isolated = landing page (tag chip hero, at-a-glance strip, warranty banner, custody / value / links panels); fitted = tag chip + status dot anchor, degrades to badge; edit = five grouped sections with EditSectionNav.

### Second consumer
The record-ops fields on a non-support, non-legal subject — this is their third consumer.
